Q: C++ faster way to do string addition? A:

String addition is not slow. Your code is slow.

When should I use operator+(std::string const&, std::string const&) for concatenation?
Never.
What, never?
No, never.
What, never?
Well, hardly ever.

(with apologies to W. S. Gilbert)

When you write added_data = added_data+data;, the following happens:

  • operator+ creates a local temporary std::string and allocates memory
  • operator+ copies the characters from added_data into the local temporary
  • operator+ copies the characters from data into the local temporary
  • operator+ returns the local temporary string. This temporary value is passed as the argument to std::string::operator=(std::string&&)
  • operator= throws away the existing content of added_data and deallocates the memory.
  • Because we have move semantics, operator= doesn't have to allocate memory and copy the data from the temporary. It just steals the data outright.

Always use std::string::append or std::string::operator+= to concatenate strings. And don't write pessimizing wrappers around it (data is passed by value, which means the compiler makes a copy for you).

Q: C# / .NET - System.CommandLine: Making the command line case insensitive A:

If nothing in your options or arguments is case-sensitive then you can do this as a one-liner:

    args = args.Select(a=>a.ToLowerInvariant()).ToArray();

at the top of your Program.cs.

This won't handle programs that take filename/path arguments for a case-sensitive file system or url scheme.

Q: Stable-Diffusion webui-user.bat gets stuck after "Model loaded" A:

I've tried different things to fight this problem, but in the end it looks like the problem was with the busy port. Just try to restart your ui with any other free port, for example like this:

./webui.sh --port 4545

If it won't help, you may also try to remove your config.json file and cache directory to reset the default settings.

If it won't help either, you may try to debug your problem, specifying different loglevel like this:

./webui.sh --loglevel DEBUG

Q: how to get access to the messages that we send itself to telegram bot? A:

Guess the only way is to create a new bot as listener. Telegram bot is designed to interact with users, so if self-sent messages are included in getUpdates, it can be confusing. Another way is to use loggings in your own program.

Q: How to export Allure report to artifacts in gitlab ci job? A:

Resolved. Check where report stores after task and specify this path to artifacts

> Task :allureReport
 Report successfully generated to path/build/reports/allure-report

automation_tests:
  stage: autotests
  script:
    - chmod +x gradlew
    - echo "Starting automation testing"
    - ./gradlew test --tests testClass
    - echo "Automation tests were executed"
    - ./gradlew clean build allureReport
  artifacts:
    when: always
    paths:
      - build/reports/allure-report/
    expire_in: 1 hour
